title: 第21章 武阳城第22章 激烈对战
slug: 脸盲宗主她又抓错人了
content_zh:
“前辈竟将灵族至宝菩提心送予了另外一个男人！”灵泽眉头紧皱，看向自己的妹妹。
“本以为前辈寻菩提心是为提升自身修为…………”
“原是为了博取那不知名男子的欢心！”灵婉冷哼一声。
随之皓腕一翻，那颗通体浑圆，寒气逼人的银珠便消失在了她的掌心之中。
“兄长，你可还记得临行前，母亲对我二人的叮嘱？”灵婉的声音带着一丝冷意。
灵泽微微颔首，手中那金光流转的长鞭也随之隐去：“自然记得。”
“母亲说，无论如何，你我二人之中，必须有一人成为前辈的道侣……”
“可如今这情形……”他面带难色地看向灵婉，“前辈竟已有了属意之人……这该如何是好？”
“哼！”灵婉眼中闪过一丝厉色，“不过是个男人罢了！”
“我倒要去亲眼瞧瞧”
“此人究竟是何等姿色，竟能胜过我们灵族之人，迷得前辈将菩提心都拱手相送！”说罢，她抬脚便要冲出栖霞阁。
“妹妹！”灵泽眼疾手快地一把抓住她的胳膊，“你就这样去吗？”
灵婉脚步一顿，低头看了看自己身上略显普通的衣裙，这才将迈出的脚收了回来……
此时，寒露殿内。
白露正四肢舒展地躺在柔软的大床上。
双眼无神地盯着精美的床幔顶部。
话说回来……自己最近是不是太懒了？
虽说刚从灵族回来不久。
但总觉得那些曾经爱不释手的话本子。
如今也显得有些腻歪了。

要不然……去凡间走一趟？
这个念头刚在脑海中划过。
白露便双眼放光地“噌”一下从床上坐了起来！
这是个绝顶的好主意啊。
她自从穿到这个世界后，还没正儿八经的去凡间逛过呢。
要是没记错的话。
云雾山脉脚下就有一座巨大的凡人城池——云城。
那正是合欢宗庇护的凡人城镇。
然而，思索片刻后，白露又打消了这个念头。
因为她记起来这个城池的城主好像就是合欢宗的人。
里面还混杂着许多合欢宗的弟子。
自己并不想人前显圣，还是不去云城了吧……
content_en:
"Senior actually gave the Bodhicitta, the most precious treasure of the spiritual race, to another man!" Lingze frowned and looked at his sister.
"I originally thought that my predecessors were seeking bodhicitta to improve their own cultivation..."
"It was just to win the favor of the unknown man!" Lingwan snorted coldly.
Then Hao turned her wrist, and the round, cold silver bead disappeared in her palm.
"Brother, do you still remember what mother told me before leaving?" Lingwan's voice had a hint of coldness.
Lingze nodded slightly, and the long whip with golden light in his hand also disappeared: "Of course I remember."
"My mother said, no matter what, one of you and me must become the senior's Taoist companion..."
"But now this situation..." He looked at Lingwan with a troubled expression, "Senior already has someone he likes... What should we do?"
"Huh!" A sharp look flashed in Lingwan's eyes, "He's just a man!"
"I'd like to see it with my own eyes."
"What kind of beauty does this person have? He can actually be better than the people of our Spiritual Clan. He was so fascinated that the seniors gave him Bodhicitta!" After saying that, she raised her feet and rushed out of Qixia Pavilion.
"Sister!" Lingze grabbed her arm with quick eyes and hands, "Are you going like this?"
Lingwan paused, looked down at the slightly ordinary dress on her body, and then took back her stepped foot...
At this time, inside the Hanlu Palace.
Bai Lu was lying on the soft big bed with her limbs stretched out.
He stared blankly at the top of the exquisite bed curtain.
Speaking of which...have you been too lazy lately?
Although I just came back from the Spirit Clan not long ago.
But I always feel like those story books that I couldn’t put down.
Now it seems a little boring.
Otherwise... take a trip to the mortal world?
This thought just crossed my mind.
Bai Lu sat up from the bed with a "pop", her eyes shining!
This is a very good idea.
Since she came to this world, she has never really visited the mortal world.
If I remember correctly.
There is a huge mortal city at the foot of the Yunwu Mountains—Yuncheng.
That is the mortal town protected by the Acacia Sect.
However, after thinking for a moment, Bai Lu gave up the idea.
Because she remembered that the city lord of this city seemed to be from the Hehuan Sect.
There were also many disciples of the Hehuan Sect mixed in there.
I don’t want to appear holy in front of others, so I might as well not go to Yuncheng...
